title: Component 2 practice: one full section
subject: English Literature
unit: Spring 1: Component 2 mastery: Macbeth and An Inspector Calls; Literature mock
source: Written for english-literature/y11 lesson 44 (Component 2 practice questions (teacher-written, pupil PDF))
intro: Open book. Choose ONE question from your weaker text. 5 minutes to plan, 30 to write, 3 to check.

questions.q: An Inspector Calls: EITHER How does Priestley present the differences between the older and younger generations? OR How does Priestley present Mrs Birling?
questions.a: AO1 15, AO2 15. Generations: Birling and Mrs Birling refuse responsibility while Sheila and Eric change; Act 3 split. Mrs Birling: cold, class-conscious, blames 'the father of the child'; dramatic irony as it is Eric.

questions.q: Macbeth: EITHER How does Shakespeare present the supernatural in Macbeth? OR How does Shakespeare present Macduff?
questions.a: AO1 10, AO2 10, AO4 10. Supernatural: the witches, the dagger, Banquo's ghost, the apparitions; James I's Daemonologie. Macduff: loyalty to Scotland, grief ('all my pretty ones'), the avenger who ends tyranny.
